title: UI/UX - Design for Displaying Policy Limits and Deductibles at Claim Level and Section Level

walkthroughSteps.title: Policy limits
walkthroughSteps.body: Policy limits are shown per type and amount here, with Deductibles listed separately below.
walkthroughSteps.expectedAfterClick: No interaction here — this step is pointing at the section itself. A claim/section level toggle above switches which level's limits and deductibles are shown.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Policy limits and deductibles are shown at both claim and section level
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: The Limits & Deductibles page shows **Policy limits** and **Deductibles** as separate sections, with a level toggle to switch between claim-level and section-level values.

setup.description: Uses CLM-2024-001's existing limits/deductibles data — no override needed

preconditions.text: Policy limits section visible with a level toggle

expectedUI.description: Policy limits table and Deductibles table, level toggle above
visualCues: Policy limits table with type + amount

howToTest.expectedResult: Policy limits and Deductibles sections both visible
